## Bio

Jake Sinkowitz is an MPH student at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health and a medical student at the Georgetown University School of Medicine. He intends to pursue residency in internal medicine.

## Education

**The University of California, Berkeley** | Berkeley, CA

B.S. in Microbial Biology 2020

## Interests

Improving healthcare delivery for the unhoused community, people living with HIV, and people who use drugs.
